instruction.text: Read the sentences below and choose the reason for them being split into paragraphs.

atoms.a:
Last year, I was so unfit that I got out of breath walking up the stairs. I wanted to be fitter, so I started going to the gym.

This year, I’m competing in running races every Saturday. I feel really fit.

“Careful! You’re going to hurt yourself,” exclaimed Jack.

“I won’t. I’m very good at this,” explained Millie.

My favourite animal that lives in the sea is the sea turtle. Sea turtles are fascinating creatures. They are one of the earth’s oldest species.

My favourite animal that lives on land is the lion. Lions need around 20 hours of sleep each day, and they are very social animals.

The children were fast asleep in their bedrooms after a long, exciting day.

Meanwhile, Father Christmas was in the living room delivering all the presents.

Last month, I found maths really hard, especially fractions.

Now, I feel more confident because my brother started helping me.

“I am really sad you’re leaving. It won’t be the same without you,” said Martin.

“I am very sad too, but I’ll be back soon,” said Nicky.

Sophie is playing video games upstairs in her bedroom.

In the kitchen, her dad is cooking his speciality dish for dinner. It will be delicious.
